messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change only the camera setup to a full-body orbit shot that starts in front, circles the person through 360 degrees, and returns to the front view. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a full-body orbit shot that starts in front, circles the person through 360 degrees, and returns to the front view. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands mostly still in the center of the frame, turning his body and head to look around the room.","camera":"A full-body shot that slowly orbits around the man, changing the viewing angle from front to side to back.","clothing":"A dark, high-collared military-style uniform with a row of gold buttons down the chest, a belt, and dark trousers and shoes.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair.","identity":"A slender, pale-skinned man with a gaunt face and prominent cheekbones.","scene":"A large, futuristic room with a glossy, reflective floor and large windows showing a stylized, neon-lit cityscape with glowing rings and structures."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a front full-body view matching the reference framing, then the camera orbits around the standing man, showing side and back angles before returning to a front view. The man remains in the same futuristic plaza and performs similar standing/turning motion.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a full-body 360-degree orbit starting from the front, circling the person and returning to the front, while preserving the person's appearance, action, timing, and scene.
uncertain: Exact preservation of the person's subtle facial expression and action timing cannot be fully verified from the frames.
unexpected_changes: The background appears more heavily stylized and distorted during parts of the orbit, with warped structures and stronger color shifts than in the source.
